findings.message: The file may have changed since it [was checked](1).
findings.rationale: The named path is opened O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK; held-descriptor reads are bounded and EOF-probed, and full9 path/descriptor metadata must match before/after reads and after close. No bytes from a substituted pathname are accepted. Later pathname execution is a separate documented boundary.
findings.reviewedBy: Independent Opus work_review concurred; manager accepted exact source-bound false positive (no second review after revision)

findings.message: Insecure creation of file in [the os temp dir](1).
findings.rationale: The reported sink opens O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and never creates a file. The SARIF source is an intentionally rejected mutually exclusive authority fixture, which fails before this read; the reader independently requires a regular singly-linked file, bounded size, full9 identity, SHA-256, and terminal path checks.
findings.reviewedBy: Independent Opus work_review concurred; manager accepted exact source-bound false positive (no second review after revision)
